_comment: TRIAS sound design manifest for tools/audio/generate-sfx.mjs. Ids map to Resources/TRIAS/Audio/Sfx/<id>.ogg and are loaded by RelayEffects with the procedural MatchSound clip as fallback.
style: close-miked game sound effect, dry, no music, no voice

pulse-shot.p: futuristic energy carbine single shot, tight punchy low-mid thump with a clean short rising electronic chirp, dependable and rhythmic, sci-fi arena shooter

pulse-alt.p: charged energy carbine shot, deeper punch with a resonant ceramic ring tail, controlled and clean, sci-fi

scatter-shot.p: brutal heavy sci-fi shotgun blast, massive low-end boom, compressed air crack and metal rattle, very punchy and short

scatter-alt.p: focused heavy slug from a sci-fi shotgun, tight concussive crack with deep sub-bass punch and short metallic ring

lance-shot.p: precision railgun sniper shot, sharp supersonic electric crack with a thin high whine that snaps off, surgical and clean

lance-alt.p: railgun capacitor charge-release, brief rising high-pitched whine then a piercing electric crack

arc-shot.p: volatile electrical arc gun discharge, crackling high-voltage zap with buzzing sparks and an unstable sputter

arc-alt.p: overloaded tesla coil burst, violent crackling electric discharge with sizzling sparks and a buzzing decay

rift-shot.p: unnatural spatial rift weapon discharge, reversed whoosh sucking inward then a deep hollow implosion thump with warped pitch, eerie

rift-alt.p: space tearing open, low warped rumble, glassy ceramic shards fracturing, reverse swell, otherworldly

rift-discharge.p: dimensional rift collapsing, deep warped implosion with glass-like crystalline crackle and a sub-bass drop

pulse-open.p: light alloy energy carbine reload start, releasing the cassette latch, crisp polymer and metal clack

pulse-insert.p: sliding a slim energy cassette into a carbine until it clicks, precise

pulse-close.p: carbine charging slide pulled and released, light satisfying metal snap

pulse-equip.p: raising a light carbine, quick fabric rustle and a soft latch click

pulse-dry.p: single dry trigger click of an empty light carbine

pulse-impact.p: small energy bolt hitting a ceramic tile, crisp snap with a tiny crackle

scatter-open.p: heavy steel break-action shotgun opening, hinge clunk and shells ejecting with a metallic tinkle

scatter-insert.p: pushing two thick shells into a heavy shotgun breech, firm metallic thunks

scatter-close.p: heavy shotgun action snapping shut and locking, solid powerful clunk

scatter-equip.p: lifting a heavy steel shotgun, weighty rattle and a hard latch

scatter-dry.p: heavy hammer falling on an empty shotgun chamber, dull metal click

scatter-impact.p: shotgun pellets peppering a metal wall, dense spray of sharp impacts

lance-open.p: precision rifle bolt unlocking and pulled back, finely machined smooth metal slide

lance-insert.p: inserting a slender needle cartridge into a precision rifle, small exact click

lance-close.p: precision rifle bolt pushed forward and locked, smooth then a crisp final click

lance-equip.p: raising a long precision rifle, smooth metal shoulder and a soft scope click

lance-dry.p: light precise dry trigger click of an empty sniper rifle

lance-impact.p: railgun slug striking metal plate, sharp ricochet ping and crack

arc-open.p: unlatching a battery cell from an electrical weapon, contacts disconnecting with a small spark crackle

arc-insert.p: seating a heavy battery cell into contacts, click followed by a short electrical hum

arc-close.p: electric weapon powering up after reload, rising capacitor whine and crackle

arc-equip.p: electrical weapon switched on, buzzing hum and small sparks

arc-dry.p: empty electric weapon trigger, weak fizzling spark

arc-impact.p: electric bolt striking metal, sizzling crackle and buzz

rift-open.p: heavy ceramic containment gate rotating open, grinding stone-like scrape with a low hum

rift-insert.p: sealing a glass reactor ampoule into a containment chamber, glassy clink and pressure hiss

rift-close.p: containment vanes closing around an energy core, ceramic clack and a deep resonant hum

rift-equip.p: exotic weapon waking up, low warped hum swelling with faint glass shimmer

rift-dry.p: empty exotic weapon, hollow dull thud with a faint warble

rift-impact.p: spatial implosion impact, warped thud with a short sucking reverse tail

boot-metal.p: single armored boot footstep on a metal deck, solid and short

boot-soil.p: single armored boot footstep on soil and gravel

boot-water.p: single boot footstep in shallow water, small splash

landing.p: armored pilot landing on a metal deck after a jump, heavy boot thud and servo settle

jump.p: short jet pack thrust burst for a jump

air-jump.p: double jump thruster pop with a quick mechanical clack

dodge.p: quick pneumatic suit vent burst for a sideways dash, sharp whoosh

launch-pad.p: launch pad catapult, powerful magnetic accelerator thump with a rising whoosh

grenade.p: sci-fi grenade explosion, concussive boom with ceramic debris, short tail

suit-hit.p: armored suit taking a bullet hit, dull impact on plate armor with a short electronic crackle

hit-tick.p: very short subtle high-tech hit marker tick, crisp and quiet

shield-hit.p: energy shield absorbing a hit, short glassy shimmer

shield-break.p: energy shield shattering like ceramic glass with an electric crackle

elimination.p: elimination confirmed cue, deep satisfying digital thunk with a short ceramic chime

near-miss.p: energy projectile whizzing past the ear, fast near miss whoosh

echo-form.p: phase echo forming, shimmering glassy tone splitting into two, subtle

echo-fire.p: phase echo firing, crisp crystalline zap with a doubled delayed echo

echo-fade.p: phase echo fading away, soft dissolving glass shimmer

echo-rupture.p: phase echo rupturing, cracking ceramic shards and a reverse whoosh

robot-groan.p: malfunctioning service robot, distorted servo groan with glitchy speaker crackle and sparks

robot-spray.p: robot spraying pressurized corrosive coolant, harsh hiss and spit

robot-strike.p: robot metal claw swipe hitting armor, heavy clank

wave-inbound.p: ominous industrial alarm horn for an incoming robot wave with distant mechanical stomps

wave-clear.p: area secured cue, calm rising synth tone resolving with relief

ui-click.p: soft futuristic interface click, ceramic tap

match-end.p: match end sting, warm sci-fi chord swell resolving

amb-relay.p: orbital space station deck ambience, low reactor hum, distant ventilation, occasional soft metallic creaks, calm

amb-foundry.p: industrial foundry ambience, deep furnace roar, molten metal bubbling, distant heavy machinery clanks

amb-basin.p: open-air mining quarry at dusk ambience, dry wind, distant rock drill rumble, occasional falling pebbles

amb-island.p: highland river valley ambience, flowing river, gentle wind through pine trees, distant birds
